events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Born in Manchester on September 21, 1972, William John Paul Gallagher rose to fame as the iconic frontman of Oasis.

angles.name: Liam's Birthday Rockout
angles.copy: Happy 54th to the one and only Liam Gallagher! What's your favourite Oasis anthem to blast out loud?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' single anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic single 'Imagine' by John Lennon was released in the UK in 1975, four years after its initial US release and the album of the same name.

angles.name: Imagine Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since the UK release of John Lennon's 'Imagine'. Still as powerful and poignant today as it was then.

events.title: Anniversary of the first iPod unveiling
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod on October 23, 2001, promising '1,000 songs in your pocket,' revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? Twenty-five years since Apple introduced the device that changed how we listen to music forever. What was the first song you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the 1962 premiere of the very first Bond film, 'Dr. No'.

angles.name: Bond Day Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy Global James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred, of course) to over six decades of 007. Who's your favourite Bond?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Born in Liverpool on October 9, 1940, the legendary musician, songwriter, and peace activist John Lennon would have turned 86 today.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic English actor, comedian, and screenwriter John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Cleese Comedy Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedy genius, John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: Anniversary of The Beatles' 'White Album' release
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968, showcasing the band's diverse musical directions.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed their expansive 'White Album'. A double LP that broke boundaries and continues to fascinate. Which track is your go-to?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: On November 24, 1991, the world lost a legend as Freddie Mercury, Queen's flamboyant frontman, died at the age of 45.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we said goodbye to the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: Anniversary of The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' release
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released in the UK on December 3, 1965, marking a significant artistic progression for the band.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Milestone
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul'. An album that pushed boundaries and set new standards for pop music. Which track is still on repeat for you?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: On December 8, 1980, John Lennon was tragically shot and killed outside his New York City apartment, stunning the world.

angles.name: Lennon's Lasting Impact
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the music world lost John Lennon. His legacy as an artist and advocate for peace lives on. Share a memory or a favourite song.
